result.notes: Harvest API v2 uses Bearer-token auth for both Personal Access Tokens (self-serve, created in the Harvest ID Developers portal, no plan restriction) and OAuth2 apps (self-registered, for multi-account integrations). Harvest has a permanently free plan (1 seat/2 projects) so a developer can get API credentials without paying. Harvest also ships an official remote MCP server (api.harvestapp.com/mcp) documented in its help center, distinct from several community MCP implementations on GitHub. API surface is moderate: ~14 resource groups (Clients, Invoices, Estimates, Expenses, Tasks, Timesheets, Projects, Roles, Users, Reports, PTO) with standard CRUD, estimated 40-50 endpoints total.
result.one_liner: Harvest is a time tracking, invoicing, and project-budgeting tool for teams and freelancers.
